title: Schema backslide alerting pipeline for config & model changes
creator: Aisha Patel
description: Add a lightweight, low-noise alerting pipeline that detects "backsliding" in structured output quality immediately after any model or config change. The goal is to catch subtle schema regressions (field omission, type drift, unexpected nulls, semantic contract violations) introduced by model rollouts or runtime config tweaks before they affect customer surfaces. This ticket scopes the pipeline design, an evaluation sampler, scoring heuristics, integration with rollouts, and a minimal dashboard/alerting surface.
acceptance_criteria: Pipeline consumes diff events from model/config change stream and kicks off targeted evals within 5 minutes of change
Per-field schema-adherence score computed for sampled traffic and compared against historical baseline with configurable thresholds
Alerts fire when field-level backslide exceeds threshold (default: 10% absolute drop) and include suggested rollback or canary throttles
Alert payload includes sample inputs, failing outputs, model/config diff, and PR/rollout metadata to aid fast triage
Smoke dashboard in Console shows top-10 regressed fields, recent rollouts, and trend sparklines for last 7 days
implementation_notes: Design decisions: 1) Use existing eval harness to run schema checks but add new lightweight runner for fast, per-change sampling (sub-1k examples). 2) Score = weighted combination of parse-failure rate, per-field type mismatch, and semantic presence check (eg. address.line1 non-empty). 3) Maintain rolling baseline per model-config pair and compute significance using Wilson score intervals to reduce noise. 4) Integrate with rollout service to attach cause metadata and optionally pause canary. 5) Start with JSON Schema v4 compatible checks plus a small set of domain heuristics stored as codebook in S3. 6) Alerting via PagerDuty + Slack channel and attach minimal remediation playbook.
comments: 2026-02-21: Kickoff sync with PM and DX. Agreed minimal MVP: per-change sample size 500, default threshold 10% absolute drop. Aisha to prototype sampler and scoring formula.

2026-02-27: Prototype evaluated on historical rollouts. Found several false positives on low-frequency fields. Decided to add frequency-aware weighting and require at least 30 expected occurrences in sample to compute a reliable delta.

2026-03-03: Design review with Security. KMS access needed for attaching rollout metadata in encrypted alert payloads; security review required. Added security_review_required label to downstream checklist.

2026-03-07: Implementation started. Marco paired with infra to add a 'change-events' consumer that triggers an eval job. Initial jobs run in a dedicated low-cost fleet to avoid inflating production quota.

2026-03-10: First end-to-end run against staging rollout succeeded. Sampled 600 requests, detected a 12% drop in 'billing.address.country' presence when switching quantization profile. Filed followup ENG-74988 to tune quantization knob mapping.
2026-03-10: Next steps - wire alerts into console rollout UI, add canary auto-throttle hook, and expand schema heuristics set based on product team feedback.
